Body.Content: The Azure Service Fabric SDK for Windows and the Service Fabric Azure-hosted service have reached general availability (GA). Service Fabric is now generally available for deployment to Windows Server virtual machines running in Azure. This means that you can confidently deploy production workloads and that subsequent releases will offer backward compatibility. For more information, visit the Service Fabric documentation page.
Body.Markdown:
The Azure Service Fabric SDK for Windows and the Service Fabric Azure-hosted service have reached general availability (GA).

Service Fabric is now generally available for deployment to Windows Server virtual machines running in Azure. This means that you can confidently deploy production workloads and that subsequent releases will offer backward compatibility.

For more information, visit the Service Fabric documentation page.
